fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $50,000 (covers two storefront offices and two kiosk offices under a single Franchise Agreement). Existing Franchisee Expansion Program pays reduced fees: (a) $2,500 per kiosk (max two kiosks) for a Territory requiring only kiosk offices, or (b) $5,000 for a Territory requiring both kiosk and storefront offices. A separate non-refundable application fee of $500 is also charged to new franchisees. The initial franchise fee is uniformly charged and non-refundable under any circumstances.
raw_excerpt: Initial Franchise Fee . We charge a n initial franchise fee of $50,000, payable in lump sum when you sign a Franchise Agreement. ... If you qualify for the Existing Franchisee Expansion Program, you will pay a reduced initial franchise fee for your additional Territory as follows: (a) $2,500 per kiosk for a Territory that requires you to only open kiosk offices , with a maximum of two kiosks ; or (b) $5,000 for a Territory that requires you to open both kiosk offices and storefront offices.
